page_title: ARS 3-1 BUR | Arsenal v Burnley 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's it for today, Michael Oliver has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+9' Jorginho (Arsenal) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
90+6' Jorginho (Arsenal) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90+6' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) heads on.
90+3' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+1' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) replacing Gabriel Martinelli.
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Wilson Odobert (Burnley) coming on for Vitinho.
86' Dara O'Shea (Burnley) misses a complete sitter from the corner, heading the ball well wide of the left post from close in.
86' Burnley force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
85' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Josh Brownhill (Burnley) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Michael Obafemi.
83' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
83' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) can have an early bath after being sent off by the referee for a tackle that simply has no place in football!
81' The substitution is prepared. Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Leandro Trossard.
81' Here's the change. Bukayo Saka leaves the pitch and Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) comes on as a substitute.
80' Substitution. Luca Koleosho walks off the pitch and Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) comes on as a substitute.
80' Here is a change. Zeki Amdouni is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Aaron Ramsey (Burnley).
78' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) sends the corner into the box, but James Trafford intercepts it and averts the threat.
74' 3 - 1 A goal! Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) broke through the defence and struck a shot inside the right post.
74' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
73' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
70' Referee Michael Oliver sees the trip by Josh Brownhill (Burnley) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
69' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
67' Declan Rice (Arsenal) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
65' High and wide! Luca Koleosho (Burnley) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post.
63' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

59' Vitinho (Burnley) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Michael Oliver with no other option than to blow for a foul.
59' A substitution has been made. Kai Havertz goes off and Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) comes on.
57' 2 - 1 Gooal! Leandro Trossard takes over corner duties. William Saliba (Arsenal) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the left side of the net. 2:1.
57' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) will take a corner kick.
56' Referee Michael Oliver points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Burnley players celebrate.
55' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an infringement in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Burnley players aren’t happy.
54' 1 - 1 Goal! Josh Brownhill (Burnley) gets a shot away from inside the box and the effort is deflected past the goalkeeper. 1:1.
52' Gabriel (Arsenal) tries to find Gabriel Martinelli, but he puts too much power on the pass.
50' A crossfield pass from Declan Rice (Arsenal) fails to find any of his teammates.
50' Arsenal take a short corner kick.
49' Michael Oliver blows his whistle. Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) commits a foul after dangerous play.
46' Burnley failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+1' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+1' 1 - 0 Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) scores a goal with a fine header that goes inside the left post, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
43' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Kai Havertz picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders.
39' The statistic for corner kicks – 7:1.
37' Flag up against Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
37' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
36' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but James Trafford thwarts him with a nice save.
34' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
32' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) is easily saved by David Raya.
31' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) gets inside the box and tries to beat David Raya with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
30' Bukayo Saka sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Kai Havertz (Arsenal), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
30' There's an opportunity for Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
29' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' Michael Oliver blows the whistle, Dara O'Shea (Burnley) is penalised for a foul.
26' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and it's Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
24' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Kai Havertz (Arsenal) inside the box.
23' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
21' The corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is cleared away by the defence.

21' A wonderful opportunity! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) strikes from close range and hits the ball nicely towards the top right corner. However, James Trafford makes a great save as he anticipates the shot and manages to parry it onto the post.
20' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
19' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

18' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Michael Oliver blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
16' William Saliba (Arsenal) sends a long cross over to Declan Rice, but James Trafford comes forward to gather the ball.
14' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
10' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
9' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
8' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
6' Bukayo Saka bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Gabriel (Arsenal) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar.
6' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
6' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
4' Arsenal hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Burnley will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Michael Oliver.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
